description: Browse 244 pixel art effects, make your own in the project, give them sound and export sprite sheets.
longDescription: A Pixel Effects panel with pixelfx's 244 code-drawn pixel art effects: fire, explosions, water, lightning, slashes, hits, pickups, transitions and whole attacks with an actor. Play one frame by frame and change its backdrop, palette, seed, frame rate, length, size and its own options. Copy one into the project's pixelfx/ folder, or start a new one, edit and check its code, and import it in a web game. Give an effect sound from a script the panel renders to WAV, or from your audio model. The panel's assistant and the agent work it with its tools and a Skill. Add a transparent sprite sheet or contact sheet to the Library, or save a sprite sheet with Aseprite JSON, a GIF or single frames to pixelfx/exports/.
example.1: Make a frost nova effect for the mage's spell and use it in the game.
example.2: Recolor the fireball effect purple and export it as a sprite sheet.
panel.title: Pixel Effects
